svg.aria-label: Brass clockwork orrery: eight planets orbit the sun at true relative speeds, driven by visibly meshing gears; a fixed day/night shadow sweeps each planet.
svg.title: Brass Clockwork Orrery
svg.desc: Epicyclic gear train. One shared gear module; ring gears fixed on the orbits, sun-gear stack in the center, pinions on each planet arm. Orbital periods in true proportion (Earth = 12 s). The shadow terminator on each planet stays sunward as the planet turns.
svg.text: ORRERY · BRASS EPICYCLIC TRAIN · TRUE RELATIVE PERIODS · EARTH 12 S / ORBIT
